== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Dreamway is a massive, interconnected [[library]] of [[dream tablets]] created by [[Emriss Silentborn]] after she reached the rank of [[Herald]]. It functions as a vast repository of knowledge and serves as an expansive collection of ever-changing fictional worlds intended to provide entertainment and inspiration for artists globally. The facility's core is located beneath a massive, ancient [[men'hla tree]] and features security measures designed to prevent unauthorized use or vandalism. While the Dreamway is accessible to everyone during the day, its reach is limited; most people outside of [[Everwood]] cannot access it freely. Instead, information is typically disseminated through messages sent by [[Emriss Silentborn|Emriss]] to powerful [[Monarch factions]], which then distribute the knowledge to smaller organizations. Additionally, the Dreamway allows [[Emriss Silentborn|Emriss]] to enter the [[dreams]] of individuals across the world to provide instruction.}}
